verdict.rationale: EFTPS's public pages state the gates before a user starts. Sign-in through Login.gov or ID.me has been required since October 19, 2023, and federal agencies have a PIV/CAC option. Enrollment is done online or through Customer Service, takes up to five business days, and ends with a PIN mailed in 5–7 business days. New enrollments are business and tax-professional only, since individuals can no longer enroll. Missing for 10: a single consolidated prerequisites checklist (e.g., required EIN or bank details for enrollment), an explicit description of what identity proofing Login.gov/ID.me require, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed steps appear mid-flow.
